title: You Finished! What Next?
intro: Congratulations — in 12 weeks you learned 360 words, 120 key sentences and all the basic grammar of English. Keep your 30 minutes a day!

month4_plan.title: Month 4 plan
items: Finish the course with these 4 bonus lessons:
engVid (James): “English for Beginners: THIS, THAT, THESE, THOSE” (video)
engVid (Alex): “Grammar – Articles – When to use A, AN, or no article” (video)
Every day: one ELLLO beginner lesson (audio), then try BBC 6 Minute English (podcast).
Move to British Council A2 listening and A2 reading.
Read one Easy Stories in English story a week, then try Level 2.
Take the level test again and compare with your first score.

tip_ar: لا تتوقف الآن! راجع الجمل الـ١٢٠ مرة كل أسبوع، واستمر في الاستماع يوميًا — هكذا يتحول ما تعلمته إلى كلام طبيعي.
